project.name: bahawatch
project.description: Community Flood & Road Condition reporting — CODELYMPICS 2026. AI assist powered by OpenAI vision + chat.

dev: Backend must run first: cd server && npm run dev (port 3000)
AI service optional but enables real vision: cd ai-service && uvicorn main:app --port 8000 (needs OPENAI_API_KEY)
Web: cd web && npm run dev (port 5173) — VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
aiAssistUsage: Web floating AI button → chat: 'What's the condition of Burgos St?' → server /api/ai/chat → ai-service /chat → OpenAI or heuristic
CreatePost: selecting photo auto-calls POST /api/ai/analyze-image with base64 → vision result pre-fills severity/condition
Feed/Map: header AI summary badge calls GET /api/ai/summarize → summarizes recent posts for viewport
